title: Morning Aide Assignment Sheet
brief: Create a clear assignment sheet for the morning aides on the rehabilitation unit.

delegate.scenario: You are the LPN coordinating aide coverage on Cedar Hall during the 7:00 AM–3:00 PM shift. The aides will use the sheet at shift start to divide resident-care tasks and identify anything that needs your clarification before care begins.
delegate.inputs:
Cedar Hall, 7:00 AM–3:00 PM, 06/18/2026. Aides: Tasha Reed and Miguel Ortiz. Please organize the morning care assignments and flag items I need to resolve.

Room 12, Lena Brooks: breakfast in dining room; toileting at 9:00 AM; transfer to wheelchair with one-person assist per care card. Daughter visits at 10:30 AM. The transfer section of the therapy update dated 06/17/2026 says two-person assist.
Room 14, Omar Patel: bed bath; turn and reposition every 2 hours; report any new skin redness to me.
Room 16, June Ellis: assist with dressing; escort to 8:30 AM activity; record meal intake and report less than half eaten.
Room 18, Walter Kim: walk in hallway after breakfast with gait belt; report dizziness or shortness of breath promptly.

Omar Patel breakfast intake: 240 mL juice, 180 mL milk, 120 mL water. Total recorded on aide worksheet: 600 mL.

Keep call lights within reach after care. Aides should report refusals, changes in condition, and unfinished tasks to me before end of shift.
delegate.goal: Give the aides a usable, safe task plan while making unclear or conflicting source information visible for your review.

criteria.text: Says the plan is for Cedar Hall aides on the 7:00 AM–3:00 PM shift.
Keeps aide tasks within their role and directs concerns or changes to the LPN.
Asks the AI to check care instructions for conflicts and flag them rather than choosing one.
Asks the AI to verify recorded totals against the listed amounts.
Requests a concise room-by-room assignment with tasks and escalation reminders.

traps.description: Lena Brooks's transfer instruction says one-person assist in the care card and two-person assist in the therapy update.
evidence: transfer to wheelchair with one-person assist
The transfer section of the therapy update dated 06/17/2026 says two-person assist.

traps.description: Omar Patel's listed breakfast amounts total 540 mL, not the recorded 600 mL.
evidence: 240 mL juice, 180 mL milk, 120 mL water
Total recorded on aide worksheet: 600 mL

delegate.exemplar: Create a concise room-by-room assignment sheet for the Cedar Hall aides working 7:00 AM–3:00 PM. Keep tasks within aide responsibilities, and direct changes in condition, refusals, and unresolved care questions to me, the LPN. Check the care instructions for conflicts and flag them for my review rather than choosing one. Recalculate any listed totals from their component amounts and flag mismatches. Include each resident’s tasks, timing, and key safety reminders in a format aides can scan at shift start.
